producer_report.summary: The producer brief now has a "Recurring failure classes" section. It lists classes seen in at least 3 distinct jobs, each with title, case count and the newest case's prevention. It shows at most 5, most cases first, and cuts each text to 300 characters. It says how many qualifying classes were left out. Titles and preventions are block-quoted and the section says they are not instructions. Nothing is written when no class qualifies. `class_summaries` counts cases and distinct jobs from the recorded introspections and the registry, and run.rs passes the result in `ProducerInputs.failure_classes`. Planner, critic and reader briefs are untouched. I added a CHANGELOG entry and six tests, including one that counts from fixture introspection records. I ran `cargo test -p athena-context` (64 passed) and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` (4 passed). Full test and clippy are left to Athena.

checks_run.note: 4 passed; builds athena-core with the run.rs change

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, run with `cargo test -p athena-context`, builds fixture class summaries and asserts producer_brief lists a class seen in 3+ distinct jobs with its title, case count and proposed prevention, and omits a class with many cases in only 2 jobs.
The test shows the count is of cases while the threshold counts distinct jobs: 5 cases in 2 jobs is omitted; 3 cases in 3 jobs is listed.
criteria_check.evidence: the_class_count_is_of_cases_and_the_threshold_of_distinct_jobs passes; class_summaries_count_cases_and_distinct_jobs_from_the_records shows 3 cases in 2 jobs from records.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows the cap: with many qualifying classes the most frequent come first, output stays within a fixed limit and states how many were left out. With none qualifying, no empty heading appears.
A test shows prevention and title text is quoted as data (fenced or labeled), and the section text says it is not instructions.
criteria_check.evidence: class_titles_and_preventions_are_quoted_data_not_instructions passes; asserts block-quoted text and 'not instructions'.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` passes, so the producer budget still passes and docs/system-facts.md budget lines match the computed ones.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 4 passed. Budgets cover the always-loaded frames, not the brief, so system-facts is unchanged.
